title: School Educators' Awareness of Academic and Practice Pathways for Emerging Careers
what_it_is: School Educators' Awareness of Academic and Practice Pathways for Emerging Careers

sections.label: MOE teacher industry programmes
sections.summary: MOE organises programmes for teachers to engage industry partners and economic agencies at networking sessions to gather insights on future economic clusters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Education (MOE) also organises programmes for teachers to engage with industry partners and economic agencies during industry networking sessions to gather insights and knowledge about the future economic clusters.

sections.label: MOE career guidance resources
sections.summary: MOE headquarters sends quarterly newsletters on emerging economic clusters, and students are encouraged to seek guidance from ECG counsellors, MySkillsFuture and NTUC Youth.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The MOE headquarters, for example, sends quarterly newsletters to our teachers on the emerging economic clusters.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: For our students, we do encourage them to seek guidance from the ECG counsellors who are a lot more plugged in and they are specialists on jobs and skills that are in demand in our economy.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: MySkillsFuture portal has a treasure trove of information about jobs and skills in demand.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Also, we know that there are organisations out there, such as NTUC Youth, that reach out to students to provide mentorship and advice.
